name: Web To Print Shop : GoSendEx
author: w2pshop

sections.description:
Web To Print Shop : GoSendEx Plugin

GoSendExpress is an innovative platform for file sharing and client collaboration. GoSendEx allows large files transfer, that the average file sharing site cannot handle, to be seamlessly shared within seconds. Our platform is embedded with top security measures to ensure all files are shared safely. Files sent on GoSendEx can be programmed to auto -delete after being shared, dropped to email, google drive, ect., or be saved on the platform for backup. GoSendEx supports all businesses and integrates with web-to-print technology guaranteeing a smooth experience for all.

Features

Security
– Auto delete files
– See file activity
– 258 SSL encryption
– Custom document safeguarding
– Custom data retention policy
Custom Portal
– Add company logo
– See file activity
– Drop files to easily share with users
– Enable/disable guest upload
– Enable/disable Public download
Large File Transfer
– No need to zip large files
– Easily share large files with one click
– Up to 10gb web file upload
High Speed
– Send gigabytes of data within minutes
– Faster turnaround times
– Seamless and effortless file uploading enhances user experience
(W2P Tech)[http://webtoprint.tech/] / Online Printing Integration
– Multifile and Multi-page Uploads
– Document detection features: page size, page count, color/bw
– Page flipper option
– Integrates with W2P SHOP; uDRAW and Onlline Pricing Calculator

Third Party Code Usage

  • Uses Racad’s proprietary API endpoints at (gosendex.com)[http://gosendex.com/] and gosendex.w2pstore.com/UBook/Viewer. For more information check out our about page
  • The former is to enable the use of FTP for uploading and storing of submitted client files; the later as to send an merged file to for PDF display via a Book like experience.
  • SortableJS — used under the MIT License
  • PDF.js — used under the Apache License 2.0
sections.installation:
Requires
Plugin: WooCommerce
Plugin: Web To Print Shop: Core

  1. Unzip and upload contents of the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

short_description: GoSendEx lets you securely share large files, with self-destruct, cloud saves, and web-to-print integration for businesses.
